data: For fiscal year 2023, the year ended June 30, 2023, Microsoft reported revenue of $211.915 billion and net income of $72.361 billion, according to its Form 10-K filed July 27, 2023. Revenue rose about 6.9% from $198.270 billion in fiscal year 2022, an increase of roughly $13.6 billion. Net income, by contrast, slipped about 0.5% from $72.738 billion in fiscal 2022. Operating income grew from $83.383 billion to $88.523 billion, but the provision for income taxes rose from $10.978 billion to $16.950 billion, which offset that gain. Within revenue, Service and Other revenue grew to $147.216 billion from $125.538 billion, while Product revenue fell to $64.699 billion from $72.732 billion.
